name: Improved Flight
body:
Graceful and nimble, you have mastered the mysteries of flight.

Prerequisite: natural fly speed

Benefit: Your flying maneuverability improves by one rating. For example, if your normal maneuverability is clumsy, it becomes poor.

Special: You can take Improved Flight several times, increasing your maneuverability by one rating each time you take the feat.
